question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded", list the availability zone (suppressing repeats and including subtotal rows per zone), instance ID, display name, cached network info, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone by instance ID, and also show (by matching on display name) the variance of instance memory_mb among instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, the overall average of these per-display-name variances, and each display name’s deviation from that overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    i.availability_zone,
    i.id AS instance_id,
    i.display_name,
    iic.network_info AS cached_network_info,
    i.memory_mb,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.availability_zone ORDER BY i.id) AS rank_in_zone
  FROM instances i
  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
),
dn_var AS (
  SELECT 
    i.display_name,
    VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
  GROUP BY i.display_name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS overall_avg_variance FROM dn_var
)
SELECT 
  b.availability_zone,
  b.instance_id,
  b.display_name,
  b.cached_network_info,
  b.rank_in_zone,
  d.memory_mb_variance,
  o.overall_avg_variance,
  d.memory_mb_variance - o.overall_avg_variance AS deviation_from_overall_avg
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN dn_var d ON b.display_name = d.display_name
CROSS JOIN overall o
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  b.availability_zone,
  NULL AS instance_id,
  NULL AS display_name,
  NULL AS cached_network_info,
  NULL AS rank_in_zone,
  NULL AS memory_mb_variance,
  o.overall_avg_variance,
  NULL AS deviation_from_overall_avg
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN overall o
GROUP BY b.availability_zone, o.overall_avg_variance
ORDER BY availability_zone, instance_id

i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC), flare_memory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.window_column, oa.overall_avg_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb), CombinedResults AS (SELECT pv.display_name AS entity_name, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, pv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, pv.variability_category AS category, 'Prime display-name cache-update variability' AS reason FROM prime_variability AS pv UNION ALL SELECT fm.instance_uuid AS entity_name, fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb AS metric_value, fm.overall_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_value, CASE WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'ABOVE_OVERALL_AVG' WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb < 0 THEN 'BELOW_OVERALL_AVG' ELSE 'AT_OVERALL_AVG' END AS category, 'Flare3 instance memory deviation' AS reason FROM flare_memory AS fm) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, benchmark_value, category, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name

WITH shelved_metadata AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid), top_memory_range_display_names AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_info_cache FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid, sm.display_name, sm.power_state, sm.metadata_value, sm.network_info, sm.window_column, sm.total_rows_per_key, sm.avg_power_state_per_key, tmr.display_name AS top10_display_name, tmr.memory_mb_range, tmr.memory_mb_variance, tmr.memory_mb_stddev, tmr.has_active_info_cache FROM shelved_metadata AS sm JOIN top_memory_range_display_names AS tmr ON sm.display_name = tmr.display_name ORDER BY tmr.memory_mb_range DESC, sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid

WITH RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), CombinedInstanceView AS (SELECT idfb.instance_uuid, idfb.display_name, idfb.vm_state, idfb.power_state, idfb.memory_mb, idfb.vcpus, idfb.instance_extra_id, idfb.max_instance_id_next_2, rgb.root_gb_range, rgb.root_gb_variance FROM InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS idfb LEFT JOIN RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS rgb ON rgb.DISPLAY_NAME = idfb.display_name) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceView ORDER BY instance_uuid

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg

WITH top_groups_2014 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT tg.DISPLAY_NAME AS group_display_name, tg.LAUNCHED_AT AS group_launched_at, tg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology AS group_has_numa_topology, AS tg LEFT JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = tg.DISPLAY_NAME AND i.LAUNCHED_AT = tg.LAUNCHED_AT LEFT JOIN forge_instances AS fi ON fi.instance_uuid = i.UUID GROUP BY tg.DISPLAY_NAME,
